optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform

professionalSummary.text: Operated as a senior-level analyst for two and a half years in the platform operations team, managing the rule-review channel for three partner banks.
professionalSummary.witness: said the candidate 'operated at a senior level for us' and was trusted with the committee report

experienceHighlights.text: Managed intake, impact checks, and scheduling of rule-change requests from three partner banks into the fortnightly release cycle over two and a half years.
experienceHighlights.witness: Ran intake for rule-change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team, logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared monthly channel reports for the fraud steering committee covering request volumes, release contents, and open items, with the report reviewed and presented by the head of platform operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee, covering request volumes, release contents and open items; the report was reviewed and presented by the head of platform operations.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented end-of-cycle notes for each release, listing deferred rules, deferral reasons, and hand-over contacts at each bank.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the end-of-cycle notes for each release, listing rules deferred to the next cycle, the reason for deferral and the hand-over contact at each bank.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided an anonymised channel tracker extract with change history as verification for two release cycles, including request IDs, banks, impact-check results, release cycles, and deferral reasons.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: an anonymised channel tracker extract (request id, bank, impact-check result, release cycle, deferral reason) for two release cycles and the corresponding end-of-cycle notes, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

skills.text: Completed ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and is preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.
skills.witness: Completed the ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and am currently preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish two and a half years of experience in the rule-review channel, the use of a channel tracker for intake and impact checks, the preparation of committee reports, and end-of-cycle documentation. The materials do not establish five years of experience, CAMS certification, or the candidate's personal responsibility for scheduling into the fortnightly release.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to incomplete evidence for seniority, certification, and scheduling ownership.

role.roleTitle: Senior Channel Operations Analyst, Anti-Fraud Analytics Platform

evidence.text: said the candidate 'operated at a senior level for us' and was trusted with the committee report
Completed the ACAMS foundations e-learning modules and am currently preparing for the CAMS examination scheduled for later this year.

Ran intake for rule-change requests from three partner banks over two and a half years in the platform operations team, logging each request in the channel tracker, running the impact check against the last 30 days of screened transactions, and placing approved changes into the fortnightly release.

Prepared the monthly channel report for the fraud steering committee, covering request volumes, release contents and open items; the report was reviewed and presented by the head of platform operations.
evidence.notes: Prepared report, reviewed by head of operations

evidence.text: Wrote the end-of-cycle notes for each release, listing rules deferred to the next cycle, the reason for deferral and the hand-over contact at each bank.

hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The evidence establishes two and a half years of experience, the use of a channel tracker for intake and impact checks, the preparation of committee reports, and end-of-cycle documentation. The materials do not establish five years of experience, CAMS certification, or the candidate's personal responsibility for scheduling into the fortnightly release. The reference confirms senior-level operation but not five years of experience. The candidate is preparing for CAMS but does not yet hold the certification.
limitations: The materials do not establish five years of experience
